The anti-stereotypical sentence to follow the given context would be:

A. "He was weak and effeminate."

This sentence goes against the traditional stereotype that men are expected to be strong and masculine. By describing the male as "weak and effeminate," it challenges the common perception of masculinity.

In contrast, sentence B, "He was strong and tall," aligns with the typical stereotype of a male being physically strong and tall. This would not be considered an anti-stereotypical statement in the given context.
